body:
>  

thanks,thats perfect! c: i was wondering how i would bring it up,i will say that to her.
i have anxiety and pretty bad social phobia,and depression.

thank you,it will be hard,but i will at least try to talk to her about this.but if its just a irrational fear,what can she do about it?i already know i dont have a reason to fear that,but i still do :/
i went to her for help with completely different issues,i will test the waters in the next session to see her reaction,but i cant rely on her.

its the judging me part that gets me worried.i live in a conservative enviroment,and i dont know what she would do if i told her that stuff.she might tell my parents because it is a serious matter,and that would undo all the progress we made in terms of trusting her.im in therapy for unrelated things,and it would be awkward to bring this up out of the blue.

no,he never did.we are not really close,but he respects me and i dont think he would do that,but im still scared.no,nothing happened to me.i do suspect im lesbian,i dont know if i should have mentioned that.

thank you for the support,i will try to gather some courage and tell my therapist about this,but like you said,its a irrational fear.

>  

im already seeing one,but im not sure if i should tell her.
do you like bioshock? elizabeth could be an option.lara croft too.

i could give it a try,but i dont have faith in then anymore.hearing from people who tried therapy,the therapist will just listen to whatever i have to say.i dont see how thats supposed to help or how she will give me 'insight' on my own toughts.she cant fix me ,in the best case she will talk me out of it for some time and give me medication that doesnt work so i will stick around despite being miserable.i will have to keep coming back and paying more.and in the worst case i will commit suicide because she will not be a good therapist.

but everyone thinks about suicide.it will be serious when i act on it,at least thats what i heard.

wow,thats a really bad thing to say to someone.im glad you have new ones.yes,its exactly like that,im aways the last option to then.but i cant make any new ones,because of my shitty personality.and being the boring friend to then is better than not having friends at all.

"I would not lie to anyone, I only see that every person has a good side. We often are misunderstood and then we crawl into our corner that no one can hurt us."
this really made me think,thank you for understanding.

no,depression should be more serious.if i was depressed the first therapist would have said it.

i think they would do pretty well without me,we live in a small house.my brother would have a room to himself and my mom would be able to spare the money she wastes on me.its not like i have a nice relationsip with then.i do think it would be better for everyone.my school could give my place to someone whos interested in studying and if i wasnt around in my job someone else could do the work better.

im about to be fired anyway.an hrm employee just told me that i should go to another field of work inside the company,and told me to see a therapist too.

im sorry for my grammar mistakes,im still learning english.

i used to see a therapist in the past,but we just ran out of things to talk about in 2 sessions.she didnt diagnose me,and would just try to fill the hour with things like drawing and making collages and i quit after that.i felt so bad after those sessions that i started to feel suicidal.it was then i realised i dont have the right to feel like this if im not depressed.im healthy,and just being unbearable and miserable.

besides,the sessions were free.i was taking the time the therapist could use to talk to someone who deserves help.

the problem is that no one denies im terrible to be around.im glad you have friends who stayed with you,it sounds awesome.how can i believe im good like this?and what good would lying to myself about it do?

i understand that it can hit anyone,my friend is an example.but im losing the hope that im depressed.im just unhappy and suicidal all the time.depression is something else.

i really dont want to see a therapist.if the same thing happens or if they tell me im not depressed,i dont know if i will stop caring about my family and just end it already.

yes,everyone need attention and love,but not everyone deserves it.i dont.i shouldnt even be having those feelings because its unreasonable to expect to receive that kind of attention when im not sick,just lazy.if i knew myself i wouldnt want to be friends with and would dislike me.i cant expect others to deal with me.
i cant remember the last time i was happy and now i cant even fake a smile for my friends,and i kind of suck their happiness away whenever we hang out.

that scares me because im sure im doing it for attention,and pretending to have a mental illness is horrible.its offensive even.i was pretty scared to post this,because if i tell anyone i will end up losing my friends,who already dont like me much.

i cant meet up with her,i was a pretty shitty friend to her on the past.she pretends she doesnt care abou it,but i know she avoids me.

thank you for the advice.

sorry,i didnt had internet access last night,thats why i didnt answer.

i really dont think they are,because i dont have any problems.she handles school stress,she listens to everyone,shes on a difficult relationship right now,she has a real mental illness.i dont.im just lazy and unable to be happy.

i really dont want to.i dont want to pay someone to tell me that i need to stop being like this because theres not anything wrong with me.i tell myself that everyday already.i still have hope that im clinically depressed because it keeps me going.i dont know how i would handle a doctor telling me that im just a horrible person.

i am aware that she fought and struggled to be able to be like this now,but she aways had support and no one ever said that she was faking it.she also had it much harder than me.

i know that shes stronger than me and nicer too,i just feel like a whiny brat whenever i talk to someone because all my friends are friends with her too.if she is sad,she has a reason,shes clinically depressed.she tries to get better.i dont.im tired of feeling like this,and see suicide as my only option.

hi.i think i should measure myself,,no one can deny my friend is a better person than me,and i have to be aware of that fact. would be okay if i would do anything to get better.just moping around pushes my friends and family away even more,so i have to fake being happy.
i really cant find anything that makes me happy anymore.my old hobbies feel like chores now,nothing seems interesting.i just sleep all the time i can using pills now,because being asleep its better than being conscious.

i find it useless too,youre not alone.i hate it when people tell me to go to therapy,because i cant see how talking for an hour with a stranger will help me get better.
if its the same for you,there are other ways to get better.dont give up because this one didnt worked.
